# The Monolith
The sector is named for it, and nobody has seen it. [color=pink]The Monolith[/color] is the anomaly at the heart of Colossus: the reason ships cannot leave, the reason the dead do not always stay dead, and, some say, the reason Kyphrus fell.
What people [italic]have[/italic] seen are its pieces.
## Scions
A [bold]Scion[/bold] is a black stone about the size of a person. Wire it to a ship's grid and it gives power for nothing. Draw harder and it gives more: matter, healing, reach, a shield no gun can break.
It is never really free. The stone hums when it is fed. The more it gives, the louder it gets, and the louder it gets, the closer it comes to waking. Crews who draw too long start to hear whispers, and then a song.
## The Remade
When a Scion sings loud enough, the dead around it get back up. The [bold]Remade[/bold] are what is left of the crews who drew too much: corpses wearing their old faces, hunting the living for the stone.
A Scion that reaches the end of its song roots in place as a [bold]Prime[/bold], and the whole sector hears it.
## In the Coda
Scions are found far out, in [textlink="the Coda" link="WFLoreUnmooring"] past the reach of [textlink="the Lattice" link="WFLoreLattice"]: dark hulls drifting with a stone bolted to the deck, and sometimes a dead freighter calling for help with one already deep in its walls. Garbled voices on the common channel give rough coordinates to anyone listening. The coordinates are never quite right.
Some hulls have keepers. [textlink="The Choir" link="WFLoreChoir"] mind the stones and warn visitors off once.
## The machines
Older things than the Remade wander the sector's wrecks: golems, gestalts and hell locusts of living crystal, which the first explorers called [color=pink]Monolithic[/color]. They guard fragments of the stone and do not negotiate.
To fight an outbreak, see [textlink="The Monolith and the Remade" link="WFRemadeGuide"] in the guidebook.
